name: Raymond Realty Ltd
tagline: Post-demerger MMR developer with a ~Rs 52,000cr GDV pipeline trading at ~12x P/E and 2.3x P/B; pre-sales inflection is real but debt tripled in FY26 and operating cash flow stays negative for ~2 more years
business_overview: Raymond Realty is the real-estate arm demerged from Raymond Ltd, developing large residential/commercial projects on Raymond's own Thane land bank plus new Joint Development Agreements (JDAs) across Mumbai (Sion, Wadala, Mahim, Kandivali).
fundamentals_table: Rs ~3,543 Cr (screener, Aug 2026; ~Rs 3,950 Cr on 25-Aug price)
36.3%  /  29.6% (screener trailing; the earlier 6.28% ROCE figure was stale/incorrect)
Gross debt Rs 231cr (FY24) -> Rs 467cr (FY25) -> Rs 1,014cr (FY26); net debt Rs 824cr Q1 FY27, D/E 0.7x vs a self-imposed 1.0x ceiling; cost of debt ~9.6%; no promoter pledge
Negative and worsening: -Rs 226cr (FY24), -Rs 237cr (FY25), -Rs 910cr (FY26); management guides negative OCF for ~2 more years (pipeline reinvestment)

FY26 revenue Rs 2,991cr; Q1 FY27 revenue +38% YoY to Rs 527cr, EBITDA +71% to Rs 70cr (13% margin), PAT -19% to Rs 13.4cr (interest cost Rs 47cr vs Rs 15cr). FY26 pre-sales Rs 3,023cr +31% (vs 20% guided); Q1 FY27 pre-sales Rs 700cr +129%
Total GDV ~Rs 52,000cr (Thane owned ~Rs 25,000cr + 8 JDAs ~Rs 27,000cr); stated project surplus cash flow >Rs 14,000cr
fundamentals_narrative: Deep read (FY26 AR + Q1 FY27 concall + Aug-2026 investor presentation) confirms the inflection and materially corrects the balance-sheet picture. ROCE is ~30% and ROE ~36% on screener's trailing figures, not the 6.28% previously recorded. Reported PAT is genuinely lumpy under percentage-completion recognition: quarterly net profit ran Rs 60cr / 67cr / 161cr / 13cr from Sep-25 to Jun-26, and the Q1 FY27 dip is explained by a 3x jump in interest cost (Rs 47cr vs Rs 15cr) plus front-loaded launch costs, not demand. Pre-sales are the real signal and they are accelerating: FY26 +31% vs 20% guided, Q4 FY26 +139%, Q1 FY27 +129% with no new launches. FY27 guidance is ~20% pre-sales and revenue growth, 17-19% EBITDA margin (vs 13% in Q1, H2-weighted) and ~20% ROCE. The bear point is now sharper and quantified: gross debt tripled to Rs 1,014cr in FY26, FY26 CFO was -Rs 910cr, and management explicitly guides ~2 more years of negative operating cash flow as it funds an 8-JDA pipeline. Governance at the entity level is clean -- unmodified audit opinion from joint auditors (Walker Chandiok + Chaturvedi & Shah), promoter holding up from 48.87% to 50.93% over the year, and a formal no-encumbrance declaration -- though the Raymond parent carries a documented history of minority-shareholder friction, so promoter-parent RPTs remain a watch-item.
technical_read: Not checked this pass -- forum-level project economics were the primary signal (an institutional research note and multiple broker mentions are already referenced in-thread).
sentiment_summary: Read most recent 50 of 235 posts (single batch; thread activity dense enough to consider a second batch, but content had already stabilized around a consistent, well-supported thesis by post ~200). The thread evolved through several concrete real-time catalysts: a Rs 1,519 Cr Q4 FY26 pre-sales beat, a Rs 8,500 Cr JDA signed (Jul 2026), promoter entity (Raymond Ltd) buying shares on the open market right before insider trading windows closed, and growing institutional/brokerage coverage (Negen Undiscovered Value Fund took a 1% stake; multiple broker notes referenced).
community_signal: Multiple trusted (elevated-tier) users engaged substantively and favorably: Pujan_Shah shared concall/media coverage and noted the stock trades at ~20x PE vs. industry 25-35x; gaurav confirmed Raymond Realty's #1 market-share position in Thane West and defended the collections-lag-vs-presales pattern as normal construction-linked-payment-plan timing; vikas_sinha (invested) flagged a declining collections/pre-sales ratio as a valid watch-point; Maheshcm and Aloysius_De_Sa both pushed back constructively on the Q1 FY27 PAT-dip skepticism, calling pre-sales/collections momentum healthy.

trusted_signals.note: Confirms Raymond Realty (Ten X District) emerged as the top seller in Thane West for 2026 and among top players over the trailing 12 months -- concrete market-share evidence, not just sentiment.

Despite retail skepticism over the Q1 FY27 PAT dip, assesses pre-sales/collections momentum as healthy given the Mumbai selling season and 12-18 months of built-up supply; expects momentum to continue.
Flags a declining collections-to-pre-sales ratio as a valid watch-point (discloses being invested) -- a balanced caution, not a bear call.

bse_notes: FY26 AR (AGM 14-Jul-2026): unmodified joint-auditor opinion, no contingent liabilities flagged, Rs 2/share dividend. Jul 2026: 8th JDA signed -- Parel / South Mumbai, ~Rs 8,500cr GDV, ~Rs 700cr peak investment, partner takes ~40% revenue share. Promoter (Raymond Ltd group) holding rose to 50.93% (Jun 2026) from 48.87% (Jun 2025); no-encumbrance declaration for FY26. Aug 2026: Q1 FY27 results + multiple investor meets (Nirmal Bang, others). FY27 launch calendar: Mahim ~Rs 2,500cr GDV (Q3), Mahim ~Rs 2,000-2,200cr GDV (Q4), Parel ~18 months out.
bull_case: Rs 52,000cr GDV pipeline (Thane owned ~Rs 25,000cr + 8 asset-light JDAs ~Rs 27,000cr) and a stated >Rs 14,000cr project surplus cash flow against a ~Rs 3,543cr market cap -- the market capitalises only a fraction of the stated pipeline value

Pre-sales inflection is demand-proven and accelerating: FY26 +31% (vs 20% guided), Q4 FY26 +139%, Q1 FY27 +129% with no new launches; management has beaten its own pre-sales guidance and hit its 50-50 JDA mix target a year early
Cheap for the growth and returns: ~12x trailing P/E, ~2.3x P/B, ROCE ~30%, ROE ~36%; entity-level governance clean (unmodified audit, promoter buying to 50.93%, no pledge)
Catalyst-rich next 9 months: Mahim launches in Q3/Q4 FY27 and H2 quarters where revenue recognition and EBITDA margin (17-19% guide vs 13% in Q1) should step up
bear_case: Leverage ramp is aggressive: gross debt Rs 231cr -> Rs 467cr -> Rs 1,014cr across FY24-FY26, net debt Rs 824cr, and FY26 CFO of -Rs 910cr; management guides ~2 more years of negative operating cash flow, so the thesis rests on multiple more years of debt-funded execution

Reported PAT is lumpy under percentage-completion accounting (quarterly net profit swung Rs 60cr/67cr/161cr/13cr) -- the market appears to wait for delivered PAT before re-rating, so the NAV gap can persist for years
Mumbai residential is cyclical and rate-sensitive; a slowdown in launch cadence, RERA approvals or the collections-to-pre-sales ratio would hit both the P&L and the ability to service rising debt
Raymond parent has a documented history of minority-shareholder friction; promoter-parent related-party transactions post-demerger are a governance watch-item even though the FY26 audit was clean
verdict_headline: Real, demand-proven pre-sales inflection and a deeply discounted pipeline -- but a debt-funded, multi-year, cyclical execution story, so Medium-High not higher
verdict_reasoning: The deep read confirms the core thesis: a Rs 52,000cr GDV pipeline vs Rs 3,543cr market cap, pre-sales up 31% (FY26) and 129% (Q1 FY27), guidance repeatedly beaten, and a cheap multiple (~12x P/E, 2.3x P/B) on ~30% ROCE -- with clean entity-level governance

It also quantifies the risk that keeps this at Medium-High: debt tripled to Rs 1,014cr in one year, CFO was -Rs 910cr in FY26, and management guides ~2 more years of negative operating cash flow -- the NAV realisation needs years of leveraged execution through a Mumbai residential cycle
Conviction confirmed at Medium-High; not floor-forced (no trusted_conviction_floor_active) -- it rests on the pre-sales evidence and the valuation, tempered by leverage and lumpy reported earnings

market_expectation.implied_growth_cagr: At ~12x trailing P/E and ~2.3x P/B the market prices roughly steady mid-teens earnings growth and a standard developer NAV discount -- capitalising only a fraction of the stated >Rs 14,000cr project surplus against a Rs 3,543cr market cap. To justify a ~20-22x exit P/E, ~25-30% EPS CAGR FY26-FY28 is needed; the pre-sales trend (+31% FY26, +129% Q1 FY27) supports the top end IF percentage-completion recognition follows within 2-3 years.
market_expectation.our_fy27_estimate: Revenue ~+20-25%, EBITDA margin recovering toward 17-19% (H2-weighted), PAT rebound after the Q1 interest-cost dip; pre-sales ~Rs 3,600cr (+20%)
market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: Second leg as FY26-27 pre-sales convert to recognised revenue and Mahim/Parel launches contribute; PAT materially higher on a larger revenue base with interest cost normalised as a share of sales
market_expectation.gap_basis: Market applies a standard developer NAV discount and a low P/E on lumpy reported PAT; the Rs 52,000cr GDV pipeline, asset-light JDA model, rising promoter stake and repeatedly-beaten pre-sales guidance are not in the multiple. Offsetting and why this is not 'underestimated': gross debt tripled to Rs 1,014cr in FY26, CFO was -Rs 910cr, and ~2 more years of negative operating cash flow are guided.

value_chain.theme: Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) residential redevelopment / premium housing
value_chain.position: asset-light developer using JDAs on third-party land plus its own ~60-acre Thane land bank; #1 market share in Thane West (Ten X District)
value_chain.bottleneck_node: development rights in prime MMR micro-markets + RERA approval throughput
value_chain.note: Post-RERA MMR residential has consolidated toward branded, balance-sheet developers; smaller builders are squeezed on approvals and funding. Raymond's asset-light JDA model adds GDV (~Rs 52,000cr pipeline, 8 JDAs) without heavy land capex, but it competes with far larger listed peers for redevelopment societies.

drivers: operating leverage on a larger launched portfolio
interest cost (rising -- a PAT drag, not an EBITDA drag)
earnings_quality.normalised_note: Through-cycle EBITDA margin guided at 17-19%; Q1 FY27 at 13% is BELOW normal (launch-cost front-loading + recognition timing), so margins are not at a cyclical peak. Reported PAT is currently depressed by interest cost tripling to Rs 47cr (from Rs 15cr) as debt funds the pipeline.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Reported net profit by quarter Sep-25 -> Jun-26: Rs 60cr, 67cr, 161cr, 13cr -- dominated by project-completion recognition, not a clean trend. Pre-sales YoY is the leading signal and it is accelerating: FY26 +31%, Q4 FY26 +139%, Q1 FY27 +129%; the P&L lags pre-sales by ~2-3 years.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: At ~12x trailing P/E the multiple demands only mid-teens sustained earnings growth. The pre-sales pipeline and beaten guidance support well above that, but because the reported print is lumpy the market appears to wait for delivered PAT before re-rating -- so the rate-of-change is not yet being paid for.

management_quality.capital_allocation: First full post-demerger year: aggressively reinvesting -- gross debt Rs 231cr (FY24) -> Rs 1,014cr (FY26), CFO -Rs 910cr FY26, ~2 more years of negative OCF guided to build an 8-JDA pipeline. Asset-light JDA structure (landowner bears rehab + approvals, partner ~40% revenue share) limits land capex; reported ROCE ~30%, guided ~20%.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Moving from a single Thane land bank to a diversified MMR redevelopment platform (Bandra, Mahim, Sion, Wadala) and, with the Parel JDA, into South Mumbai premium (ticket sizes Rs 6-20cr)
